fences.rule: Across the passage the copy held beyond someone's reach changes whose reach and what it repairs: there it lives beyond the institution's reach and gives a fact standing before others, here it lives beyond the subject's own revising hand or the narrator in their house and repairs the subject's reliance on the record.
fences.case: A founder after a blown company who gives a friend the log and the right to read it back unedited.

fences.rule: If the item is a bodily state that precedes and informs a call, it belongs there; if it is a mechanism that rebuilds reliance on a judgment already made unusable, it is here.
fences.case: The gut drop of a wrong decision recognized late.

fences.rule: If the check is run inside a live exchange to keep composure, it belongs there; if it catalogues the weather in which one's judgment fails and trusts the judgment outside it, it is here.
fences.case: Rating your tiredness in the middle of a deal and discounting the next judgment by it.

fences.rule: If the object is the return itself, the returner coming back inscribed with the interval, it belongs there; if the object is the clean page built in a new domain before the walk back, it is here.
fences.case: The trader who lost the fund, two seasons at sea, back able to say what he now does with a bad read of the wind.
